nodes.label: Aspheric Engine (src/lib/optic-engine/aspheric.ts)
nodes.rationale: Kept independent from the spherical engine and served by its own /aspheric route so conic/polynomial surface math can evolve without destabilizing the standard spherical calculation path.

nodes.label: Frame-Type Recommendation Overrides
nodes.rationale: Half-rim requires index >= 1.56 for nylon groove tensile strength and rimless requires >= 1.61 for drill-hole durability, so mechanical survivability overrides the purely optical index choice.

nodes.label: Spherical Optical Engine (src/lib/optic-engine/optical.ts)
nodes.rationale: All spherical thickness and protrusion math is centralized in a single module, src/lib/optic-engine/optical.ts, so the UI layer only consumes computed results instead of reimplementing formulas.

nodes.label: Smart Material Recommendation Engine
nodes.rationale: Higher refractive index buys thickness reduction (~15% to ~45%) at the cost of lower Abbe value (58 down to 32), so the recommendation picks the lowest index that keeps the lens thin enough rather than always maximizing index.

nodes.label: Query-Graph-Before-Grep Rule
nodes.rationale: graphify query/path/explain return a scoped subgraph that is usually much smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep output, so raw files should only be read for lines the graph already located.

nodes.label: Intent Skill Loading Policy
nodes.rationale: Agents must load the repository's already-installed Intent skills and report a missing dependency instead of downloading a replacement, which keeps skill resolution pinned to vetted local packages; the most specific local skill wins, and cross-package work may load several.
